data.name: Subhendu
data.long_meaning: The name Subhendu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘subh’ meaning good, and ‘endu’ meaning intelligence. This name signifies a person who is intelligent and has good judgment. It is a name for a boy who is wise, courageous, and intelligent.
